name: moneybird-mcp
description: Chat with your Moneybird bookkeeping: invoices, contacts, bank mutations and reports — changes only after a preview you approve.
long_description: Connects Claude to your Moneybird administration. Read invoices, purchase documents, contacts, bank mutations and financial reports; create or change things only through a strict preview-and-approve flow (nothing is ever written without your explicit 'yes', and totals are verified after every change). Includes Dutch bookkeeping prompts such as 'koppel_banktransacties' and 'verwerk_achterstand'.

access_token.title: Moneybird API token
access_token.description: Create one at https://moneybird.com/user/applications/new — choose 'Persoonlijk gebruik' (personal use) and copy the token shown.

administration_id.title: Administration ID
administration_id.description: Optional. The long number in your Moneybird URL (moneybird.com/<this number>/...). Leave empty if your token has exactly one administration.

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where the search index, approvals and audit log are stored on your computer.
